blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite the success of neural models in natural language processing, their black-box nature limits interpretability and conceals the linguistic phenomena underlying their predictions. We present SLITE, an explainable hybrid model for Recognizing Textual Entailment that integrates two complementary layers of semantic analysis: a structural-relational layer, based on semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities, and a distributional-informational layer, based on structured patterns of information change between embedding-based representations of the premise and the hypothesis. We propose 17 features that combine entity-level semantic relations, polarity-sensitive lexical matching, and alignment measures over semantic sub-representations of the similarity matrix, including measures based on entropy and transfer entropy. A logistic regression trained on these features achieves an accuracy of 83% on three-class SICK and 96% on SICK-CE, outperforming IsoLex by 4 percentage points and falling within 2 percentage points of RoBERTa with a fraction of its computational complexity. Ablation studies and SHAP analysis confirm that structural-relational features are the primary drivers of classification, while distributional-informational features provide essential complementary contributions, particularly for detecting neutrality and contradiction. Our results demonstrate that further exploration of hybrid approaches is a viable and scientifically productive alternative to massive neural architectures, and we hope they will strengthen the dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference.
blocks.zh: 尽管神经模型在自然语言处理中取得了成功,但其黑盒性质限制了可解释性,并隐藏了其预测背后的语言现象. 我们提出了SLITE,一种用于识别文本的可解释的混合模型,它融合了两个互补的语义分析层:一个结构-关系层,基于语义兼容性和组成实体之间的不兼容性;一个分布-信息层,基于嵌入式的前提和假设之间的信息变化的结构模式. 我们提出17个特征,将实体级语义关系,极性敏感语法匹配,以及类似语义亚代表矩阵的对齐度量,包括基于 en和转移 en的度量. 对这些特性进行后勤回归培训后,三等SICK的精度为83%,SICK-CE的精度为96%,优于IsoLex的精度为4个百分点,低于RoBERTA的2个百分点,其计算复杂性只有一小部分。 分布式研究和SHAP分析证实,结构关系特征是分类的主要驱动力,而分布式信息特征则提供了重要的互补贡献,尤其是对于发现中立性和矛盾. 我们的结果显示,进一步探索杂交方法是替代大规模神经结构的可行和有科学效益的替代方法,我们希望它们能加强语言理论与计算推论模型的对话.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: In the current generation of Artificial Intelligence systems, linguistic task modeling seeks to capture the intrinsic complexity of human language, marked by lexical, structural, and semantic variability and ambiguity. Within this challenge, Recognition of Textual Entailment (RTE) or Natural Language Inference (NLI) is a fundamental pillar for evaluating language comprehension, challenging computational systems to determine whether the meaning of a hypothesis ( H H ) can be derived from a premise ( P P ) ( Dagan, Glickman, and Magnini 2006 ) .
blocks.zh: 在当代人工智能系统中,语言任务建模试图捕捉人类语言的内在复杂性,其标志是语法,结构,语义的变异和模糊. 在这个挑战中,承认文本的贴近性(RTE)或自然语言推论(NLI)是评价语言理解性的基本支柱,对计算系统提出了挑战,以确定假设(H H)的含义是否可以从前提(P P)中得出(Dagan,Glickman,和Magnini 2006).

blocks.en: To make this concrete, consider the following pair of sentences: 1 . 1. A blonde woman is walking ( P P ). 2 . 2. A person is walking ( H H ). Humans are able to judge whether the second sentence (the Hypothesis) follows rationally from the first (the Premise) or, in other words, whether, given the truth of P, H would be rationally judged to be true. This interpretive task, routine in language processing, involves semantic comprehension and inferential processes sometimes supported by world knowledge, and poses a non-trivial challenge for Natural Language Processing (NLP).
blocks.zh: 为使这一具体化,考虑以下两句: 1. 1. 金发女子正在走路(PP)。 2 2. 一个人正在步行(HH ). 人类能够判断第二句(即假说)是否从第一句话(即"预言")中理性地遵循,或者换句话说,鉴于P的真实性,H是否会被理性地判断为真实. 这一解释性任务在语言处理中是例行的,涉及语义理解和推论过程,有时得到世界知识的支持,并且对自然语言处理(NLP)提出了非三角挑战.

blocks.zh: 一个金发女人正在走路。

blocks.en: A person is walking ( H H ).
blocks.zh: 一个人正在走路(HH).

blocks.en:
The recent trend in the scientific community has prioritized the development of massive neural architectures, such as pre-trained transformers. Models such as BERT, RoBERTa, and their successors dominate standard benchmarks, achieving accuracies that often exceed 95% on datasets such as SuperGLUE ( Wang et al. 2019 ) . However, these systems operate as black boxes that, despite their high performance, lack transparency in decision-making, ignore specific linguistic phenomena, and cannot account for their predictions in terms of interpretable linguistic rules or reasoning chains ( Souza and Lopes 2025 ; Yang et al. 2023 ) .
Adding to this concern is evidence that transformer models tend to exploit superficial artifacts in the datasets rather than acquiring robust inferential mechanisms ( Gururangan et al. 2018 ) . Even large-scale benchmarks such as SNLI ( Bowman et al. 2015 ) have been questioned as adequate measures of inferential competence, suggesting that progress in NLI requires not only greater accuracy but also a clearer explanation of what models actually learn.
blocks.zh:
科学界的近期趋势是优先发展大型神经架构,如预训变压器. BERT,RoBERTA等模型及其继任者主导了标准基准,在SuperGLUE(Wang等人,2019年)等数据集上实现了常常超过95%的速率. 然而,这些系统作为黑匣子运作,尽管其性能高,决策缺乏透明度,忽略了具体的语言现象,无法从可解释的语言规则或推理链来解释它们的预测(Souza和Lopes 2025;Yang等人,2023年).
此外,有证据表明,变压器模型倾向于利用数据集中的表面文物,而不是获得强有力的推论机制(Gurururangan等人,2018年)。 即使是SNLI(Bowman等人,2015年)这样的大规模基准也被质疑为充分衡量推论能力的措施,这表明NLI的进步不仅需要更高的准确性,还需要更明确地解释模型实际学到什么.

blocks.en: NLI holds a prominent place in computational linguistics. It serves both as a performance benchmark in NLP and as a window into the mechanisms and processes that underpin it. This duality makes interpretability a methodological imperative. A system capable of classifying pairs of inferences without explicitly stating the linguistic foundations of its decisions contributes little to the study of inference as a phenomenon and lacks a solid basis for diagnosing systematic errors. Beyond scientific requirements, traceability is a pragmatic necessity in critical domains such as legal reasoning, clinical medicine, or fact-checking, where the validity of a conclusion depends on its ability to be audited. In these contexts, a model’s reliability lies not only in its accuracy but also in the traceability of its inferential process.
blocks.zh: NLI在计算语言学中占有显著地位. 它既是国家劳工方案的一个业绩基准,也是作为其基础的机制和进程的窗口。 这种双重性使得可解释性成为方法上的必然。 一个能够将对子推论分类而不明确说明其决定的语言基础的系统对将推论作为一种现象的研究作用不大,并且缺乏诊断系统性错误的坚实基础. 除了科学要求外,在诸如法律推理、临床医学或事实核实等关键领域中,可追踪性是一种实际需要,因为结论的有效性取决于其审计能力。 在这种情况下,一个模型的可靠性不仅在于其准确性,而且在于其推断过程的可追溯性。

blocks.en:
The quest for explainability has taken two forms: post-hoc interpretability, which involves applying explanation methods to an opaque, pre-trained model, and inherent interpretability, in which the decision logic is transparent by design ( Rudin 2019 ; Burkart and Huber 2021 ) . Post-hoc attribution methods have demonstrated considerable utility for probing what information neural representations encode ( Belinkov 2022 ; Ferrando et al. 2024 ) ; however, when applied to opaque architectures,
they produce approximations of model behavior rather than direct accounts of it,
and the fidelity of those approximations cannot be independently verified against
the underlying decision process ( Bhalla, Srinivas, and Lakkaraju 2023 ) . This limitation is of great relevance to the understanding and explanation of automatic inference mechanisms. When the inference chain is the primary object of study, a model whose decision logic is transparent by design offers a qualitatively different type of evidence than one whose decisions are reconstructed a posteriori.
blocks.zh:
对可解释性的探索有两种形式: 热后可解释性,包括将解释方法应用于不透明,事先训练过的模型,以及内在可解释性,其中决定逻辑通过设计是透明的(Rudin 2019;Burkart和Huber 2021). 浩克后归属方法已显示出相当的实用性,用于检验信息神经表达编码(Belinkov 2022;Ferrando 等人 2024);然而,当应用于不透明架构时,
它们产生模型行为的近似 而不是直接描述它,
并且这些近似值的忠诚性无法与
基本决策程序(Bhalla、Srinivas和Lakkaraju 2023) 这一限制与理解和解释自动推论机制密切相关。 当推论链是研究的首要对象时,一个设计上具有透明决定逻辑的模型所提供的证据在质量上不同于一个其决定是事后重建的模型.

blocks.en: There have been notable efforts to restore the interpretability of distributed representations through well-founded geometric and semantic constraints ( Iwamoto, Kohita, and Wachi 2021 ; Engler et al. 2022 ) . Still, while embeddings are highly effective at capturing statistical patterns of usage in similar contexts, their interpretability is restricted to the representational level and does not extend to the inferential process. From a linguistic perspective, entailment judgments are known to depend crucially on lexical-semantic relations: in our example, the human inference rests on the relationship between woman and person . The link between such relations and propositional entailment is well established in formal and lexical semantics ( Lyons 1977 ; Cruse 2004 ; Hurford, Heasley, and Smith 2007 ; Jeffries 1998 ) and has been placed at the core of approaches such as Natural Logic ( MacCartney and Manning 2009a ) . Consequently, the nature of RTE demands a qualitative leap: implication judgments must not stem from statistical proximity, but from the structural relations between their components. Integrating distributional representations with structured symbolic knowledge—hypernymy, merony, synonymy, and antonymy—allows us to operationalize how these relationships dictate the value of the inference, thereby extending explainability from the representation to the inferential mechanism itself.
blocks.zh: 通过有根据的几何和语义限制,为恢复分布式表述的可解释性做出了显著努力(岩本、Koshita和Wachi 2021;Engler等人,2022年)。 然而,虽然嵌入法在捕捉类似情况下使用的统计模式方面非常有效,但其可解释性仅限于代表性层面,并不延伸至推论过程。 从语言的角度来看,必然性判断主要取决于语法-语义关系:以我们为例,人的推论取决于妇女与人之间的关系。 这种关系与命题联系在形式和语法语义学中早已确立(里昂,1977年;克鲁斯,2004年;赫斯利,赫福德和史密斯,2007年;杰夫,1998年),并被置于自然逻辑学(麦克卡特尼和曼宁,2009年a)等方法的核心。 因此,可再生能源的性质要求有一个质的飞跃:影响判断不能来自统计上的接近,而应来自其组成部分之间的结构关系。 将分布式表述与结构化的象征性知识——韵律、元音、同义词和同义词——结合起来,使我们得以将这些关系如何决定推论的价值,从而将解释性从表述扩大到推论机制本身。

blocks.en: The need for structured symbolic knowledge is accentuated by the intrinsic limitations of similarity measures in geometric spaces. Santus et al. (2014) demonstrate that symmetric measures, such as cosine similarity, are inadequate for capturing asymmetric semantic relations, such as hypernymy ( dog → animal ). Although distributional spaces encode semantic generality—since hypernyms typically occupy more diffuse contexts with higher entropy than their hyponyms ( Santus et al. 2014 ) —their architecture is not designed to model intrinsic semantic properties, but rather patterns of statistical co-occurrence, regardless of the knowledge resources used to enrich them. Similarly, Amigó et al. (2022) demonstrate, through their Information Theory-based Compositional Distributional Semantics (ICDS) framework, that models such as BERT or GPT suffer from a representation degradation problem : contextual representations, being optimized for language modeling objectives, often sacrifice the geometric properties required for a reliable similarity measurement.
blocks.zh: 几何空间中类似性计量的内在局限性突出了对结构化符号知识的需要。 桑图斯等人. (2014年)证明,对称措施,如余弦相似性,不足以捕捉不对称的语义关系,如超音律(狗~动物). 虽然分布空间编码语义通俗性——因为超音韵通常占据比其低音韵率更高的分散语境(Santus等人,2014年),但其结构并不是用来建模内在语义属性,而是用于统计共聚的规律,而不论用于丰富它们的知识资源如何。 同样,Amigó等人(2022年)通过其基于信息理论的构成分布语义学(ICDS)框架,证明BERT或GPT等模型存在代表性退化问题:背景表述,为语言建模目标优化,往往牺牲可靠相似度测量所需的几何特性.

blocks.en: This convergence of constraints is driving the development of hybrid methods that, without compromising performance competitiveness, operate under principles of linguistic rigor and offer inherent interpretability. Recent frameworks such as XTE and IsoLex ( Silva, Freitas, and Handschuh 2020 ; Souza and Lopes 2025 ) have demonstrated the potential of these approaches by integrating statistical filters, lexical resources (e.g., WordNet), and embedding similarity into serialized architectures. However, despite their transparency and achieving performance close to the state of the art, their modular design suffers from an intrinsic vulnerability to error propagation and the rigidity of their intermediate representations. This is particularly critical in the dependency on Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) triplets, which are insufficient to capture the structural complexity and diversity of syntactic configurations characteristic of natural language.
blocks.zh: 这种制约的趋同正在推动混合方法的发展,在不损害业绩竞争力的情况下,在语言严格的原则下运作,并提供固有的可解释性。 最近的一些框架,如XTE和IsoLex(Silva、Freitas和Handschhuh 2020;Souza和Lopes 2025),通过整合统计过滤器、词汇资源(例如WordNet)以及将相似性嵌入序列化的架构,证明了这些方法的潜力。 然而,尽管其透明度和性能接近最先进的水平,但其模块设计本身就容易受到错误传播和中间表述的僵硬性的影响。 这对于依赖主题-Verb-object(SVO)三胞胎尤其关键,这些三胞胎不足以捕捉自然语言特征的合成构型的结构复杂性和多样性.

blocks.en:
We therefore propose a framework that operationalizes
textual entailment in a non-serialized manner as an analysis of two complementary dimensions. First, we propose a Structural-Relational dimension of analysis. We construct P P and H H entities —head concepts with their attributes— in order to identify semantic compatibility relationships for the RTE task. Based on this analysis, we propose relational measures and a Jaro measure modified and extended using semantic knowledge for the RTE task. This measure is based on an analysis of the structure of P P and H H in order to establish links between their lexical units, taking into account negations (polarity) that modify their meaning and the correspondence of the link.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们提出一个框架,使
作为两个互补层面的分析,以非序列化方式产生文字意义。 首先,我们提议分析的结构-关系层面。 我们构建了P和H实体——头概念及其属性——以便确定RTE任务的语义兼容关系。 基于这一分析,我们建议采用关系措施和Jaro措施,利用语义知识修改和扩大RTE任务。 这一措施基于对P P 和 H H 结构的分析,以便在它们的词汇单元之间建立联系,同时考虑到改变其含义的否定(极性)和联系的对应性。

blocks.en: Second, we propose a Distributional-Informational dimension of analysis. We analyze structured patterns of information change between the distributional representations of P P and H H . Beyond cosine similarity, we construct sub-representations of the entity and lexical similarity matrices by selectively removing rows and columns corresponding to specific semantic groups. Alignment measures over the resulting submatrices quantify the residual coherence of the P P - H H relationship when certain relation types are absent, operationalizing information change as a structural property of the embedding-based semantic alignment. Entropy-based measures—including transfer entropy—provide a complementary view of the same phenomenon at the distributional level, quantifying directional uncertainty reduction from P P to H H .
blocks.zh: 第二,我们提出分析的分布信息层面。 我们分析了在PP和HH的分布表述之间信息变化的结构模式。 除了同位素相似性外,我们通过有选择地删除与特定语义组相对应的行和列来构建实体的子表示和词典相似性矩阵. 在没有某些关系类型时,对由此产生的子矩阵的调整措施量化了PP-H关系的剩余一致性,将信息变化作为嵌入式语义调整的结构属性投入使用。 基于Entropy的测量方法——包括转录Entropy——在分布层次上提供同一现象的补充观点,量化从PP到H的方向不确定性减少.

2 Related work and contribution
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作和贡献

blocks.en: The landscape of RTE research has evolved from rule-based and lexical overlap methods toward massive neural architectures, with an emerging line of hybrid approaches seeking to recover interpretability without sacrificing competitive performance. This section traces that evolution and situates our contribution within this landscape.
blocks.zh: RTE研究的地貌已经从基于规则和词汇的重叠方法演变为大规模神经结构,新兴的一行混合方法寻求恢复可解释性而不牺牲竞争性能. 本节追踪这种演变,并将我们的贡献置于这一格局中。

blocks.en: 2.1 Datasets and Task Evolution
blocks.zh: 2.1 数据集和任务演变

blocks.en: The task of RTE arose with the PASCAL challenges, posed as a binary entailment problem ( Dagan, Glickman, and Magnini 2006 ) . A qualitative leap was made with large-scale annotated datasets such as SNLI ( Bowman et al. 2015 ) and MultiNLI ( Williams, Nangia, and Bowman 2018 ) , which introduced the neutral category, broadening the spectrum of reasoning required. To specifically evaluate compositional semantics, the SICK ( Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge ) corpus ( Marelli et al. 2014 ) was created, characterized by a controlled design that normalizes verb tenses and avoids idioms or complex named entities. Its SICK-CE subset, containing only entailment and contradiction pairs ( Souza and Lopes 2025 ) , has become an ideal testbed for evaluating models’ ability to distinguish these core relations without the added ambiguity of neutrality. Other specialized corpora, such as SciTail ( Khot, Sabharwal, and Clark 2018 ) , derived from science questions, and the SuperGLUE diagnostic sets ( Wang et al. 2019 ) , have continued to push the complexity and diversity of the task.
blocks.zh: RTE的任务与作为二进制问题(Dagan、Glickman和Magnini,2006年)的PASCAL挑战有关。 SNLI(Bowman et al. 2015)和MultiNLI(Williams, Nangia, and Bowman 2018)等大规模注解数据集实现了质的飞跃,引入了中性分类,拓宽了所需的推理范围. 为了具体评价组成语义,创建了SICK(涉及组成知识的判决)教程(Marelli等人,2014年),其特征是控制式设计,使动词时态正常化,避免出现偶数或复杂的命名实体. 它的SICK-CE子集,只包含引子和矛盾对子(Souza和Lopes 2025),已经成为评价模型在不增加中立性模糊性的情况下区分这些核心关系的能力的一个理想的试金石. 其他专业的蝎子,如源于科学问题的SciTail(Khot,Sabharwal,和Clark 2018)和SuperGLUE诊断集(Wang等人,2019年),继续推动任务的复杂性和多样性.

blocks.en:
Pioneering methods were based on measures of lexical overlap and superficial similarity, which were quickly limited by phenomena such as negation or pragmatic implication ( Santus et al. 2014 ) .
Natural Logic ( MacCartney and
Manning 2009b ) represented a significant conceptual advance by enabling formal inference directly over
surface linguistic structures through a monotonicity calculus and lexical alignment rules. These models are intrinsically interpretable: every inference step corresponds to an explicit, human-readable operation over the logical form of the sentence.
Their coverage, however, is bounded by the expressiveness of the monotonicity calculus and the completeness of the lexical alignment rules. Hu et al. (2020a) report that MonaLog, a modern lightweight implementation of the Natural Logic paradigm, achieves 77.2% accuracy on SICK—a result that is competitive within the symbolic paradigm, though one that highlights the
performance ceiling that monotonicity-based systems tend to approach on large-scale benchmarks. Critically, this gap
persists and widens on the Logic and Commonsense subsets of SICK ( Kalouli et al. 2023 ) , which were specifically designed to target inferential phenomena that Natural Logic should handle well (see Section 5.2 for a detailed comparison), suggesting that the limitation is not merely one of
scalability but of inferential coverage.

blocks.en: The current dominant paradigm consists of neural models, first with architectures based on LSTM and attention mechanisms ( Rocktäschel et al. 2016 ; Parikh et al. 2016 ; Zhao, Huang, and Ma 2016 ) , and subsequently with the fine-tuning of pre-trained transformers such as BERT ( Devlin et al. 2019 ) and RoBERTa ( Liu et al. 2019 ) . These models have established the state of the art (SOTA) in virtually all RTE benchmarks, achieving, for example, 98% accuracy on SICK-CE in the case of RoBERTa ( Souza and Lopes 2025 ) . However, their black-box nature and tendency to learn superficial biases from the data rather than deep reasoning have prompted growing criticism and the search for more explainable alternatives ( Kalouli et al. 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 目前的主导范式包括神经模型,首先是基于LSTM的建筑和注意力机制(Rocktäschel et al. 2016; Parikh 等人 2016; Zhao, Huang, and Ma 2016 ),随后对BERT(Devlin 等人 2019)和RoBERTA(Liu 等人 2019)等经过预训的变压器进行了微调. 这些模型在几乎所有RTE基准中都确立了最新技术(SOTA),例如,在RoBERTa(Souza和Lopes 2025)中,SICK-CE的准确度达到了98%。 然而,它们的黑盒性质和从数据中吸取肤浅偏见而不是深刻推理的倾向引起了越来越多的批评和寻找更合理的替代办法(Kalouli等人,2023年)。

blocks.en:
An emerging area of research seeks to combine the predictive power of statistical approaches with the transparency of symbolic methods.
One proposal is the XTE (Explainable Text Entailment) model ( Silva, Freitas, and Handschuh 2020 ) , designed to overcome the opacity and rigidity of traditional systems. Instead of operating as a black box, XTE integrates specialized components (one for syntactic analysis and another for semantic analysis), which are activated on a case-by-case basis. Its architecture allows it to generate justifications in natural language for each decision and base its reasoning on external structured knowledge, such as dictionary definitions, thus reducing dependence on biases present in the training data. This hybrid approach proved its effectiveness, achieving an F1 score of 0.59 in an adaptation of the SICK dataset, where the contradiction and neutral categories were grouped under a single non-entailment label.
blocks.zh:
一个新兴的研究领域试图将统计方法的预测力与象征性方法的透明度结合起来。
其中一项提议是XTE(解释性文本细节)模式(Silva, Freitas, and Handschuh 2020),旨在克服传统体系的不透明性和僵化性. XTE不是作为黑匣子运行,而是整合了专门的组件(一个用于合成分析,另一个用于语义分析),这些组件是逐个启动的. 其架构允许它用自然语言为每项决定提出理由,并以字典定义等外部结构化知识作为推理依据,从而减少对培训数据中存在的偏见的依赖。 这种混合方法证明了它的有效性,在SICK数据集的改编中实现了0.59的F1分,其中矛盾和中性分类被归在一个单一的非尾贴标签下.

blocks.en:
A parallel line of research has explored the potential of Information Theory as a foundation for semantic representation and inference. Santus et al. (2014) demonstrated that distributional entropy can capture asymmetric semantic relations such as hypernymy that symmetric measures like cosine similarity cannot, grounding semantic generality in the diversity of contextual distributions. Amigó et al. (2022) extended this perspective through their ICDS framework, showing that information-theoretic composition can provide a more principled account of meaning than geometric operations over embedding spaces. More recently, Staliūnaitė and
Vlachos (2025) have pointed to the potential of semantic entropy for modeling ambiguity and label variation in RTE. Together, these works suggest that Information Theory offers tools that are both formally grounded and linguistically interpretable—properties that, to our knowledge, have not yet been exploited in the form of directional information flow features for RTE classification.

平行的研究路线探索了信息理论作为语义表述和推论基础的潜力. 桑图斯等人. (2014)证明分布式 en可以捕捉不对称的语义关系,如超音韵,像余弦相似度这样的对称度量不能实现的超音韵,将语义通论建立在背景分布的多样性上. Amigó等人(2022年)通过他们的ICDS框架扩展了这一视角,表明信息理论构成可以提供比嵌入空间上的几何操作更具原则性的意义描述. 最近,Staliūnaitė和
Vlachos(2025年)指出语义 en在RTE中具有模型模糊和标签变化的潜力. 这些著作合在一起表明,“信息理论”提供了各种工具,这些工具既具有正式基础,也具有语言解释能力,据我们所知,这些工具尚未以RTE分类的方向信息流动特征的形式加以利用。

blocks.en:
The most direct precedent for our work is IsoLex ( Souza and Lopes 2025 ) , which serves as our primary baseline. Its serialized architecture, however, presents two limitations that motivate our design. First, the pipeline structure is prone to cascading errors, where missteps at intermediate stages propagate uncorrected to the final classifier. Second, and more fundamentally, the reliance on Subject-Verb-Object (SVO) triplets for structural representation constrains syntactic coverage in ways well-documented in the information extraction literature ( Banko et al. 2007 , inter alia) . Complex constructions such as relative clauses ( the man who was running ) and secondary predication ( she left angry ) are frequently misanalyzed or discarded by SVO extraction pipelines. While passive alternations ( the instrument was put away by the woman ) pose challenges for both SVO and dependency-based representations, the latter preserves the essential argument structure required for semantic analysis rather than silently omitting it. Given that such constructions are prevalent in naturally occurring sentence pairs, a representation that fails to capture them systematically underrepresents the structural evidence necessary for accurate entailment judgments. Unlike IsoLex, which relies on WordNet for lexical relation extraction, our approach uses ConceptNet ( Speer, Chin, and
Havasi 2018 ) , whose richer relational inventory and compatibility with dense vector representations make it better suited to our non-serialized architecture.

我们工作的最直接先例是IsoLex(Souza和Lopes 2025),它是我们的首要基准。 然而,其系列化的架构提出了两个限制因素,激励着我们的设计。 首先,管道结构容易出现串联错误,中间阶段的错步会传播给最终的分类器. 第二,更为根本的是,依赖主题-Verb-object(SVO)三重结构代表制限制了在信息提取文献中详细记载的合成覆盖(Banko等人,2007年等等)。 诸如相对条款(运行中的人)和二次预测(她生气地离开)等复杂构思经常被SVO提取管道误解或抛弃. 虽然被动交替(文书被妇女删除)对SVO和依赖性表述都构成挑战,但后者保留了语义分析所需的基本论据结构,而不是默默省略。 鉴于这种构思在自然发生的一对句子中普遍存在,未能系统地捕捉到这种构思的表述代表了准确作出判决所需的结构证据。 与依赖WordNet进行词汇关系提取的IsoLex不同,我们的方法使用ConceptNet(Speer, Chin,以及

blocks.en:
Another line of work is represented by the Semantic Knowledge Abstraction (SKA) proposal ( Torres-Moreno and Hermosillo-Valadez 2026 ) .
The SKA framework reconfigures the lexical-semantic relationships between P P and H H into four functional categories—equivalence/generality, opposition, specificity, and no relation—that align with the logical classes of entailment, contradiction, and neutrality. This categorical representation reduces reliance on surface-level lexical patterns and provides a structured basis for semantic compatibility judgments. In the present work, we reformulate these notions within a formal dependency-based framework and extend their operationality as the symbolic backbone of our feature set, combining them for the first time with information-theoretic measures of directional information flow to produce a unified, non-serialized representation of the P P - H H relationship.
blocks.zh:
另一行工作由语义知识摘要(SKA)提案(Torres-Moreno和Hermosillo-Valadez 2026)代表.
SKA框架将PP和HH之间的语法-语义关系重新划分为四个职能类别——等同/一般、反对、具体和无关系,这四个职能类别与必然产生、矛盾和中立等逻辑类别相一致。 这种绝对的表示减少了对表层词典规律的依赖,并为语义兼容性判断提供了结构化的基础. 在目前的工作中,我们在一个正式的依赖性框架内重新拟订这些概念,并扩展其可操作性,作为我们一套特征的象征性支柱,首次将它们与定向信息流动的信息理论计量结合起来,形成一个统一的、非序列化的P-H关系。

blocks.en:
These hybrid approaches collectively demonstrate
that the perceived trade-off between performance
and interpretability in RTE is far from an inherent
necessity; rather, it reflects the current dominance
of opaque neural architectures, which has obscured
the potential for high-performing, explainable models.
Yet no existing model simultaneously addresses the
structural limitations of serialized pipelines, the
geometric constraints of cosine-based similarity,
and the requirement for directional information flow.
Our proposed architecture addresses each of these
limitations directly through its two complementary
layers of analysis: the Structural-Relational layer
overcomes the rigidity of serialized pipelines and
cosine-based representations, while the
Distributional-Informational layer operationalizes
directional information flow as a structural property
of the P P - H H semantic alignment.

blocks.en:
Our proposal differs from previous work in two key
conceptual and methodological aspects:
blocks.zh:

概念和方法方面:

blocks.en:
1. Structured Semantic Analysis. Unlike IsoLex and other models that rely on
rigid extraction of SVO triplets, vulnerable
to syntactic variation, we perform an analysis
of entities and their attributes based on
syntactic dependencies, which we term the Structural-Relational layer of analysis.
We categorize the entities within H H into four
disjoint groups based on their semantic
relationship with P P : equivalence/generality,
opposition, specificity, and no relationship.
Based on this analysis, we propose two types
of measures: relational features that quantify
the distribution and interaction of semantic
groups, and a semantically extended Jaro measure
that establishes links between the lexical units
of P P and H H using ConceptNet relations,
incorporates polarity-sensitive matching to
account for negation, and applies directional
penalties reflecting the type and correspondence
of each link. Together, these measures
operationalize directed semantic coverage at
a level of granularity that pure distributional
approaches cannot encode directly. 2. Quantification of Information
Flow. While most models, including IsoLex,
rely on cosine similarity as their primary
measure of semantic proximity, our Distributional-Informational layer goes
beyond this by analyzing structured patterns
of information change between the distributional
representations of P P and H H . Prior work has
established the relevance of distributional
entropy for capturing asymmetric semantic
relations ( Santus et al. 2014 ) , and
information-theoretic composition has been
proposed as a principled alternative to
geometric operations over embedding spaces ( Amigó et al. 2022 ) ; however, these approaches
operate at the level of individual word
distributions rather than at the level of
structured semantic sub-representations. Our
proposal extends this line of work by
constructing sub-representations of the
similarity matrices through selective removal
of rows and columns corresponding to specific
semantic groups, and computing alignment and
entropy-based measures, including transfer
entropy ( Schreiber 2000 ) , over the
resulting submatrices, operationalizing
information change as a structural property
of the P P - H H semantic alignment.

Both contributions share a fundamental requirement
for the underlying knowledge resource: it must
support simultaneous access at the symbolic level
and the distributional level. WordNet ( Fellbaum 1998 ) , employed by IsoLex, is
structured primarily around taxonomic hierarchies,
offering limited coverage of the non-taxonomic
relations required by our feature set. ConceptNet ( Speer, Chin, and
Havasi 2018 ) ,
by contrast, provides a richer relational inventory
and grounds its concepts in Numberbatch embeddings,
enabling unified symbolic and distributional
operations within a single resource. A detailed
justification of this choice is provided in
Section 3 .

The framework proposed here operates across two

measures of information change between P P and H H (see Figure 1 ). The following
subsections introduce the representational
primitives common to both layers: the entity and
lexical representations, the similarity matrices,
and the semantic categorization of relations.

ConceptNet ( Speer, Chin, and
Havasi 2018 ) is selected as the primary knowledge resource because it provides a broader range of semantic relations than WordNet, including meronymy, antonymy, and commonsense associations, which are essential for modeling entailment and contradiction in RTE tasks. In addition, its multilingual graph structure and integration with Numberbatch embeddings ( Speer, Chin, and
Havasi 2018 ) enable both symbolic reasoning over explicit relations and distributional analysis through dense vector representations within a unified framework. This combination is particularly suitable for our non-serialized architecture, where symbolic and distributional analyses must operate over compatible representations.

blocks.en:
In what follows, we treat each word in a sentence as a concept in the
sense of ConceptNet: a lemmatized lexical item that may participate in directed relational edges within the knowledge graph.

We follow the methodology of ( Torres-Moreno and Hermosillo-Valadez 2026 ) . Consider two concepts c 1 c_{1} and c 2 c_{2} (note that the notion of concept applies to each member of the entities and their respective attributes). Hierarchical levels in ConceptNet are interpreted in terms of extensional generality : a concept c 2 c_{2} is at
a higher level than c 1 c_{1} if the extension of c 2 c_{2} properly includes that of c 1 c_{1} (e.g., animal ⊃ \supset dog ), corresponding to a hypernymy or I ​ s ​ A IsA relation directed from c 1 c_{1} upward to c 2 c_{2} . This interpretation is consistent with the distributional entropy account of Santus et al. (2014) , where more general
concepts occupy more diverse contexts.
We define semantic compatibility and incompatibility between c 1 c_{1} and c 2 c_{2} in a general setting as follows.

Hence, we adopt the following convention. When one or both entities carry no attributes, the universal quantification is satisfied vacuously, and the semantic relation between the entities is determined solely by the head concept. Indeed, an entity without modifiers imposes no additional constraints on its referent, so the absence of attributes should not block an otherwise valid semantic relation between heads. For example, if P P contains car and H H contains vehicle (both without attributes), the generalization relation between the heads is sufficient to establish ℛ g ​ n \mathcal{R}_{gn} , and the empty attribute condition does not interfere. blocks.en: Our semantic categorization and alignments are grounded in well-established work in lexical and formal semantics. Classical accounts distinguish relations such as synonymy, hyponymy, and antonymy, among others ( Lyons 1977 ; Cruse 2004 ; Murphy 2003 ) , which can be naturally interpreted as set-theoretic relations between denotations. Under this view, for example, synonymy corresponds to equivalence, hyponymy to set inclusion, and antonymy to various forms of semantic exclusion. These relations have long been known to connect with propositional relations, specifically entailment ( Cruse 2004 ; Hurford, Heasley, and Smith 2007 ; Jeffries 1998 ) . In fact, entailment relations between propositions have traditionally been a useful tool to define sense relations for semanticists ( Lyons 1977 ) . Based on these well-established theoretical connections between lexical-semantic relations and proposition entailments, our rationale is justified as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的语义分类和调整的基础是在语法学和正式语义学方面的既定工作。 古典的说法区分了同义词,低音词,和动词等关系(里昂1977年;克鲁斯2004年;墨菲2003年),这自然可以被解释为调音之间的定理关系. 例如,在这个观点下,同义词对应等同词,下同义词对应设定包含,上同义词对应各种形式的语义排斥. 长期以来,这些关系一直与命题关系联系在一起,具体来说就是牵扯关系(Cruse 2004;Hurford, Heasley, and Smith 2007;Jeffries 1998)。 事实上,命题之间的必然关系历来是界定语义学家感性关系的有用工具(里昂,1977年)。 基于语法-语义关系与命题关系之间的这些既定理论联系,我们的理由有如下理由:

blocks.en:
• General and equivalent relations correspond with Entailment: both the relations included under “general relations” (such as hyperonymy, meronymy….) and those under “equivalent relations” (synonymy), impose a relation between sentences such that the truth of P (e.g., there is a man) makes H necessarily true (e.g. there is a person) ( Cruse 2004 ; Hurford, Heasley, and Smith 2007 ) . • Opposite and difference relations, which encode semantic incompatibility, correspond with Contradiction. First, opposite and difference relations (antonyms, complementaries, converses, directional opposites, as well as co-hyponyms and co-meronyms etc.) include lexical items that cannot be predicated of the same entity as true simultaneously. These lexical relations impose a logical contrary relation between sentences: the truth of one entails the falsity of the other ( Cruse 2004 ; Jeffries 1998 ) . Consequently, if P and H differ in a pair of concepts that are opposites or different, P does not entail H: The truth of P does not allow to infer the truth of H. Second, regarding “concrete relations”, the truth of the more general term (higher in the lexical hierarchy), by definition, does not entail the truth of the less general term subordinated in the scale ( Cruse 2004 ; Jeffries 1998 ) . • Relations of specificity do not license entailment but instead give rise to neutrality. When the hypothesis is more specific than the premise, it introduces additional information that is not guaranteed by the premise and therefore cannot be inferred from it. In set-theoretic terms, this corresponds to a narrowing of the denotation: while the extension of the hypothesis may be included within that of the premise, the direction required for entailment is reversed, and thus the inference does not hold. This asymmetry is well documented in formal semantics. Such cases fall under the category of neutral, since the hypothesis may be true given the premise, but is not necessarily so. Furthermore, neutrality in NLI is a heterogeneous and theoretically
contested category. Unlike entailment and contradiction, which correspond
to well-defined logical relations with relatively stable annotation
criteria, the neutral class has been a persistent source of disagreement
in the literature: it groups together pairs that are thematically
independent, pairs where the inference is blocked by pragmatic rather
than semantic factors, and pairs where H H introduces information more
specific than P P —all under a single label that conflates logically
distinct phenomena ( Kalouli et al. 2023 ; Gururangan et al. 2018 ) . This annotation
instability is not incidental: Kalouli et al. (2023) show that inter-annotator agreement is substantially lower for neutral pairs than for entailment and contradiction across multiple NLI datasets, and that models trained on neutral examples are more susceptible to learning spurious correlations precisely because the category itself is less coherent.
Our framework addresses this heterogeneity operationally: the categories 𝒢 s ​ p \mathcal{G}_{sp} and 𝒢 n ​ r \mathcal{G}_{nr} provide distinct operational handles on two of the most
common sources of neutrality—specificity and absence of
relation—while the classifier is exposed to their interaction with equivalence and opposition signals simultaneously. This explicit decomposition allows the model to distinguish, at least partially, between types of neutral pairs that a single label obscures, and provides a principled basis for diagnosing the cases where neutral classification fails.

blocks.en: In this sense, the alignment between semantic categories and task classes should be regarded as a necessary, but not sufficient, condition. For a pair to be classified as entailment, all relations between entities should ideally correspond to relations of generality or equivalence ( 𝒢 e ​ q \mathcal{G}_{eq} ), without the presence of opposition or specificity. However, the existence of relations of generality or equivalence does not necessarily imply entailment, since such relations may also occur in pairs belonging to other classes. In contradiction pairs, several relations of generality and equivalence may coexist with a single relation of opposition ( 𝒢 o ​ p \mathcal{G}_{op} ). Nevertheless, it is precisely this opposition relation, regardless of its relative frequency, that determines the class and overrides any positive evidence. Similarly, in the neutral class, relations of generality, equivalence, and even moderate opposition may occur simultaneously. What distinguishes this class is the presence of specificity ( 𝒢 s ​ p \mathcal{G}_{sp} ) or unrelated new information ( 𝒢 n ​ r \mathcal{G}_{nr} ), which prevents both entailment and direct contradiction.
blocks.zh: 从这个意义上讲,语义类别和任务类别之间的协调应被视为一个必要但还不够的条件。 要将一对关系归类为必然关系,实体之间的所有关系最好都与一般关系或等同关系(G e q \mathcal{G}_{eq})相对应,而不存在反对意见或具体性。 然而,存在一般性或等同性关系并不一定意味着必然产生这种关系,因为这种关系也可能发生在属于其他类别的对等关系中。 在矛盾对称中,一些泛泛和等同的关系可能与反对的单一关系(G o p\mathcal{G}_{op})并存. 尽管如此,正是这种反对关系,无论它的相对频率如何,决定了等级,压倒了任何积极的证据. 同样,在中性阶级中,一般性,等同性,甚至温和的反对的关系也可能同时发生. 区别于此类的是特异性的存在(G s p \ mathcal{G}_{sp})或不相关的新信息(G n r\ mathcal{G}_{nr}),它既防止了产生,也防止了直接的矛盾.

blocks.en: This asymmetry—where opposition is determinative, specificity and no-relations introduce ambiguity, and generality or equivalence require contextual interpretation—supports the need to model not only the presence of each relation type, but also their interactions and relative contributions. As noted above, the presence of equivalence or generality relations does not guarantee entailment, nor does their absence necessarily imply contradiction. Instead, class membership depends on the interaction between these positive signals and the presence of opposition or specificity. By explicitly modeling these interactions, the proposed feature set can disentangle the often ambiguous contribution of generality and equivalence, thereby improving class discrimination.
blocks.zh: 这种不对称性——如果反对是决定性的、具体的和没有关系的,则会产生模糊性,而一般性或等同性则需要根据背景作出解释——支持不仅需要模拟每种关系类型的存在,而且还需要模拟其相互作用和相对贡献。 如上所述,存在等同关系或一般关系并不保证产生这种关系,也不一定意味着矛盾。 相反,阶级成员资格取决于这些积极信号与存在反对或特异性之间的相互作用. 通过明确模拟这些互动,提议的一套特征可以消除一般性和等同性往往模糊不清的贡献,从而改善阶级歧视。

blocks.en: Furthermore, working with knowledge bases and semantic searches requires establishing priorities among candidate relations. Such prioritization may exclude relations whose information could still be relevant for decision-making. Conversely, identifying a general relation first may obscure a more informative specific relation; in this sense, generalization may introduce noise into the decision process. This situation may arise across the different types of semantic relations considered in this work. The proposed set of measures seeks to mitigate these effects by focusing the analysis on combinations of specific relations, thereby reducing the influence of noise.
blocks.zh: 此外,与知识库和语义搜索合作,需要在候选关系之间确定优先次序。 这种优先排序可能排除其信息仍然与决策相关的关系。 反之,首先确定一般关系可能会掩盖一个更翔实的具体关系;从这个意义上说,一般化可能会给决策过程带来噪音。 这项工作中考虑的不同类型的语义关系可能会出现这种情况。 拟议的一套措施力求减轻这些影响,将分析的重点放在具体关系的组合上,从而减少噪音的影响。

blocks.en: Thus, by measuring the contribution of each semantic group both collectively and individually, it becomes possible to capture the distinctive characteristics associated with each class. The following section presents this proposal in detail.
blocks.zh: 因此,通过衡量每个语义组集体和个人的贡献,就有可能捕捉到与每个类别相关的不同特征。 下一节详细介绍了这项建议。

blocks.en: Entity-based features are at the core of our approach. The construction of entities allows us to model the compositional nature of language in order to give rise to semantically richer lexical units. In this way, the search for semantic relationships between these composite entities allows us to identify non-superficial relationships. For example, if H H contains ‘ red clothes ’ and P P contains ‘ red car ’, at the lexical level (isolated words) we might find that ‘ car ’-‘ clothes ’ have no relationship but ‘ red ’-‘ red ’ do, which could lead to ambiguity in determining whether P → H P\to H . Using entities, we would find that ‘ red car ’-‘ red clothes ’ are two different things, even though their attributes are similar, so there is no ambiguity in saying that P → H P\to H does not hold. Below, we formalize the process to extract our features.

blocks.en:
We complete the proposal with a set of symbolic semantic similarity features. To this end, the Jaro algorithm ( Jaro 1989 ) was implemented and extended to sentences at the lexical-semantic level with ConceptNet relations. Our proposal implements a significantly modified version of the Jaro distance, specifically adapted for RTE tasks. While preserving the concept of a search window based on the maximum sequence length, the count of transpositions, and the classic three-component formula, the proposed similarity measure works with words rather than characters, and the matching criterion is not based on exact equality but on semantic relationships as given by Definitions 1 and 2 .
Furthermore, it incorporates a polarity analysis that considers negation words to distinguish between affirmations and negations.

blocks.en: The 17 features are used as input for a Logistic Regression classifier. Logistic regression is selected for three primary reasons: first, its decision boundary is a linear combination of input features, allowing each coefficient to be directly interpreted as a measure of feature importance; second, it is computationally efficient during both training and inference; and third, it avoids introducing additional representational complexity that might obscure the linguistic analysis encoded within the features.
blocks.zh: 这17种特性被用作逻辑回归分类器的输入. 逻辑回归的选择有三个主要理由:第一,其决定边界是输入特征的线性组合,允许将每个系数直接解释为特征重要性的衡量标准;第二,在培训和推论期间,逻辑回归在计算上是有效的;第三,避免引入额外的代表复杂性,从而可能模糊特征内编码的语言分析.

blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: In this section, we detail the experimental setup, the datasets used, the comparison models, and present a comprehensive analysis of the performance of our proposal.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细介绍了实验设置、所使用的数据集、比较模型,并全面分析了我们提案的执行情况。

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Settings
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: The process applied was the one described in Section 3 , which includes lemmatization and the construction of entity representations based on the dependency tree. Next, we calculate the features described in Section 4 in order to classify them using logistic regression and determine the class of the P P and H H pairs. The logistic regression classifier was implemented using the Scikit-learn library, performing five-fold cross-validation.
blocks.zh: 适用的程序是第3节所述的程序,其中包括以依赖树为基础进行定型和建立实体代表。 其次,我们计算第4节中描述的特征,以便利用后勤回归来分类,并确定P和H对H的类别。 后勤回归分类器是使用Scikit-learn库实施的,进行五倍的交叉验证.

blocks.en: We evaluated our model on four widely used public benchmarks for the RTE task:
blocks.zh: 我们评价了我们的模式,对可再生能源任务采用了四个广泛使用的公开基准:

blocks.en: • SICK (Sentences Involving Compositional Knowledge) ( Marelli et al. 2014 ) : This dataset contains 9,927 manually annotated sentence pairs with three relations: entailment, neutral, and contradiction. We use the official partition of training (4,500 pairs), development (500 pairs), and test (4,906 pairs). • SICK C-E (SICK Contradiction-Entailment) : A variant of SICK where examples from the neutral class have been removed, resulting in a binary classification problem between contradiction and entailment ( Souza and Lopes 2025 ) . This version consists of 4,245 pairs in total, with 2,116 pairs in the test set. This partition allows for specific evaluation of the model’s ability to distinguish between entailment and contradiction. • SICK correction for MonaLog : A manually and rule-based corrected version of SICK proposed within the MonaLog framework ( Hu et al. 2020a ) . This curation focuses on identifying and fixing specific labeling errors, including asymmetric annotations, and problematic word-level differences using WordNet-based rules. The authors manually reviewed 409 proposed changes and adjudicated disagreements to create a supplementary dataset with more precise labels. • SICK-LCS (SICK Logic and CommonSense) : A re-annotated version of SICK proposal by ( Kalouli et al. 2023 ) . This disentanglement of inference types addresses inconsistencies and label noise present in the original SICK, allowing for separate evaluation of models on logical versus common-sense reasoning.
blocks.zh: • SICK(涉及组成知识的参与者)(Marelli等人,2014年): 这个数据集包含9,927个手动附加说明的句子对,有三个关系:内涵,中性,和矛盾. 我们使用训练(4,500对),开发(500对),测试(4,906对)的官方分区. • SICK C-E(SICK 对比-尾注): SICK的一个变体,中性类的例子被删除,导致矛盾和必然性之间的二进制分类问题(Souza和Lopes 2025). 这个版本共由4,245对组成,在测试集中有2,116对. 这种划分使得能够具体评价模型区分内涵和矛盾的能力。 • SICK对MonaLog的更正: 在MonaLog框架内提出的基于规则的SICK修改版(Hu等人,2020年a)。 这种校准侧重于识别和固定具体的标签错误,包括不对称说明,以及使用WordNet规则的有问题的词层差异. 作者们手动审查了409项拟议的修改,并裁定了分歧,以建立一个带有更精确标签的补充数据集。 • SICK-LCS(SICK逻辑和常识): 由(Kalouli等人,2023年)重新注释的SICK提案. 这种推论类型的脱节解决了原始SICK中存在的不一致和标签噪声,允许对模型进行逻辑推理与常识推理的单独评价.

blocks.en: We compare our model with: • IsoLex ( Souza and Lopes 2025 ) : A hybrid and explainable model for NLI that combines an Isolation Forest-based filter on BERT embeddings, lexical relation extraction using WordNet, and Word2Vec vector similarity. It is an ideal baseline due to its interpretable nature and specific evaluation in SICK C-E. • RoBERTa ( Liu et al. 2019 ) : Reported by Souza and Lopes (2025) as the state of the art for SICK C-E in their study. This model represents the upper limit of performance with approaches based on fine-tuned large language models (LLMs). • MonaLog ( Hu et al. 2020a ) : A lightweight natural language inference engine based on natural logic and monotonicity calculus. Unlike other logical systems, it operates directly on surface linguistic forms without translating into complex logical representations, using a small inventory of monotonicity facts about quantifiers and token polarity. • GKR4NLI ( Kalouli, Crouch, and de Paiva 2020 ) A system that uses Graphical Knowledge Representations (GKR). It converts sentences into semantic graphs capturing conceptual, contextual, lexical, and morphosyntactic constraints, aligns matching terms between sentence pairs, and computes the inference relation based on the specificity and instantiability of aligned terms. • Ccg2lambda1 and Ccg2lambda2 ( Yanaka et al. 2018 ) : Two variants of the ccg2lambda system, which maps inference pairs to logical formulas based on neo-Davidsonian event semantics. Both variants parse sentences into CCG (Combinatory Categorial Grammar) representations, convert them into semantic representations (directed acyclic graphs), and use a theorem prover with Natural Deduction rules. The difference lies in the CCG parser used: ccg2lambda1 employs the C&C parser, while ccg2lambda2 uses the Easy-CCG parser. • LanGPro ( Abzianidze 2017 ) : A natural language theorem prover based on CCG and λ \lambda -terms, distinguished by its use of the analytic tableau method and natural logic rules for proofs. Its workflow includes a logical form generator (LLFgen), an optional text fragment aligner, and a first-order logic theorem prover with approximately 50 hand-coded rules.

It converts sentences into semantic graphs capturing conceptual, contextual, lexical, and morphosyntactic constraints, aligns matching terms between sentence pairs, and computes the inference relation based on the specificity and instantiability of aligned terms.
blocks.zh: GKR4NLI 软件 (卡卢利、科鲁奇和德帕瓦2020年) 一种使用图形知识表现(GKR)的系统. 它将句子转换成语义图,捕捉概念性,上下文性,词典性和形态性约束,将句子对齐的术语,并根据对齐的术语的特异性和即时性计算推论关系.

blocks.en: Ccg2lambda1 and Ccg2lambda2 ( Yanaka et al. 2018 ) : Two variants of the ccg2lambda system, which maps inference pairs to logical formulas based on neo-Davidsonian event semantics. Both variants parse sentences into CCG (Combinatory Categorial Grammar) representations, convert them into semantic representations (directed acyclic graphs), and use a theorem prover with Natural Deduction rules. The difference lies in the CCG parser used: ccg2lambda1 employs the C&C parser, while ccg2lambda2 uses the Easy-CCG parser.

blocks.en: 5.4 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 定性分析

blocks.en:
To complement the quantitative evaluation, we conduct a detailed qualitative analysis of individual predictions using SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) ( Lundberg and Lee 2017 ) . SHAP provides a unified framework for interpreting model predictions by attributing each feature’s contribution to the final decision.
This analysis serves three purposes: first, to validate that the model’s decisions are grounded in linguistically meaningful patterns; second, to understand the specific failure modes that lead to misclassifications; and third, to illustrate how SHAP values can provide instance-level explanations for model behavior. Positive SHAP values push the prediction toward entailment; negative values push it toward contradiction.
blocks.zh:
为了补充定量评价,我们对使用SHAP(SHapley Additive ex Planations)的个人预测(Lundberg和Lee 2017)进行详细的定性分析. SHAP通过将每个特征的贡献归结于最终决定,为解释模型预测提供了一个统一的框架.
这一分析有三个目的:第一,验证模型的决定基于语言上有意义的模式;第二,了解导致错误分类的具体故障模式;第三,说明SHAP值如何为模型行为提供实例级解释. 积极的SHAP值将预测推向内涵;消极值将预测推向矛盾。

blocks.en:
A thorough evaluation of an RTE model requires
not only reporting performance metrics but also
examining the quality and biases of the evaluation
corpus. The SICK dataset, despite being a widely
used benchmark, presents characteristics that
restrict absolute interpretations of results.
SLITE is explicitly designed to capture a strong
directional flow of information from P P to H H ,
which makes it particularly sensitive to borderline
cases where the inference relation is ambiguous
or inconsistently annotated. This sensitivity
partly explains the performance gap between
SICK C-E (96%) and the full SICK corpus (83%),
since the neutral class is inherently heterogeneous,
encompassing both genuinely independent pairs and
those with plausible but uncertain entailment
relations, as discussed in Section 3 .

blocks.en: The ablation results support three conclusions. First, SR layer constitute the essential core of SLITE, particularly for the entailment-contradiction axis. Second, DI layer act as specialized augmentations most needed in three-class settings, where the neutral class demands sensitivity to residual coherence that SR layer alone cannot fully provide. Third, the relative contribution of each dimension is task-dependent: SR layer dominate in binary classification, while the full integration of both dimensions is required for robust three-class performance. This complementarity validates our hypothesis that robust entailment recognition requires an ensemble of linguistically motivated signals operating across different dimensions of semantic analysis.
blocks.zh: 结果支持三个结论。 首先,SR层是SLITE的基本核心,特别是对内向-连接轴. 第二,DI层在三类环境中发挥最需要的专门增强作用,其中中性类要求对剩余一致性的敏感性,而仅SR层是无法充分提供的。 第三,每个维度的相对贡献取决于任务:SR层在二进制分类中占据主导地位,而两个维度的完全融合是强力的三等性能的必要条件. 这种互补性验证了我们的假设,即强烈的内涵识别需要一系列在语义分析的不同层面操作的语言动力信号。

Table 5 presents
cross-dataset results under annotation shift,
where training and test sets follow different
labeling criteria. When trained on logic-annotated data and tested on original labels —the condition that most directly exposes reliance on corpus-specific biases— SLITE achieves 50.8% accuracy against BERT’s 29.4%, a gap of 21.4 percentage points. fails to generalize when the inference criterion
changes, while SLITE’s linguistically motivated
features provide more robust generalization
across annotation frameworks.

blocks.en: Case 3 demonstrates the model’s ability to handle structural complexity: it correctly identifies that talking parrot entails parrot is speaking despite the premise containing additional elements (microphone, muted) and a more complex syntactic structure.

blocks.en:
The four cases reveal a consistent pattern: the
feature set operates through complementarity, as
no single feature or group is sufficient for robust entailment recognition, but their orchestrated combination produces coherent and diagnosable decisions. Features such as L10 and E3 exhibit bimodal behavior, favoring entailment in some contexts and contradiction in others, with their contribution direction determined by semantic context and feature value. Structural-Relational features capture lexical-semantic alignment and directional mismatch, while Distributional-Informational features capture residual coherence and entropy patterns; their interaction ensures that when one dimension provides ambiguous signals, the other provides corrective evidence. The exception, as Case 2 illustrates, occurs when the external knowledge resource lacks the relations required to distinguish between lexically similar
but logically incompatible predicates, a limitation that defines the boundary of the current framework and motivates the future directions outlined in Section 6 .

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that L17 emerges as the most influential and balanced predictor (Entailment: 0.54, Neutral: 0.54, Contradiction: 0.44), confirming that the coverage of P P over H H is the primary indicator of inferential coherence. The high influence of L17 on the Neutral class suggests that the model uses the coverage gap as a reliable indicator that the hypothesis introduces unsupported information.

blocks.en:
A critical finding concerns the contrast between L9 and its knowledge-aware counterparts. L9 computes a global alignment by summing maximum cosine similarities between word embeddings in P P and H H , without distinguishing between types of semantic overlap. Features that operate over semantic submatrices —E5,
L10, and L11— provide substantially higher predictive power for the Neutral and Contradiction classes precisely because they isolate the contribution of specific relation types rather than aggregating over
all similarity values indiscriminately. This contrast constitutes empirical support for the core design decision of the Distributional-Informational dimension: structured sub-representations of the similarity matrix are more informative than raw alignment.

L10和L11——为中立和对立类提供了高得多的预测力,正因为它们隔离了特定关系类型的贡献,而不是汇集在一起。

Distributional-Informational features L12 and E4

L14 (SHAP: 0.28 for Contradiction) acts as a precision filter for logical conflicts, detecting contradictory matches ( c ​ m = 1 cm=1 ) at the immediate semantic level —explicit negation and antonyms that global embedding averages tend to conceal. lexical overlap. Together, the contrast between
the predictive power of these Structural-Relational features and the negligible contribution of L9 supports a central claim of this work: for RTE, the quality of semantic alignment is far more consequential than the quantity of statistical similarity.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented a hybrid approach to Recognizing Textual Entailment motivated by a central methodological question: how can the semantic relations between a premise and a hypothesis be analyzed simultaneously from a structural-relational perspective —grounded in semantic compatibility and incompatibility between compositional entities— and from a distributional-informational perspective —grounded in the patterns of information change between their embedding-based representations— so as to produce an inferential account that is both competitive and transparent by design? Our answer integrates these two dimensions into a unified, non-serialized framework that avoids the error propagation of serialized pipelines while preserving the linguistic interpretability that opaque neural architectures sacrifice.
blocks.zh: 这份文件提出了一种混合方法来认识文字上的贴近性,其动机是一个核心方法问题:如何从结构关系的角度——以组成实体之间的语义兼容性和不兼容性为基础——和从分布信息的角度——同时分析前提与假设之间的语义关系,其依据是它们嵌入式表述之间的信息变化模式,以便形成一个既具有竞争性又具有设计透明度的推论? 我们的答案将这两个维度整合到一个统一的,非序列化的框架中,避免了串行式管道的传播错误,同时保留了不透明神经结构牺牲的语言解释性.

blocks.en: A logistic regression trained on these features achieves 96% accuracy on SICK C-E and 83% on three-class SICK. On SICK C-E, our model surpasses IsoLex by 4 points and comes within 2 points of RoBERTa; a remarkable result given that our model uses a linear classifier on 17 interpretable features versus RoBERTa’s 355 million parameters.
blocks.zh: 在SICK C-E和3级SICK上接受后勤回归培训的准确度分别为96%和83%。 在SICK C-E上,我们的模型超过IsoLex 4 点,在RoBERTa的2点以内;鉴于我们的模型在17个可解释的特性上使用线性分类器,而RoBERTa的3.55亿个参数上,这是一个显著的结果。

blocks.en:
SHAP-based analysis and ablation studies validate that the feature set operates through complementarity. The primary drivers of classification are the Structural-Relational features, particularly L17 (the single most predictive feature) and E8 (the second most predictive), which dominate in both three-class and binary settings. Distributional-Informational features contribute most distinctively to neutral class detection: their removal produces a loss of 2.6 points in neutral F1 in three-class SICK, and L10, the most stable individual DI feature,
captures residual distributional coherence after removing semantically compatible terms, suggesting it is a primary contributor to this group-level effect. In binary classification, SR features alone capture most of the available inferential signal, with DI features contributing negligibly ( − - 0.3 points when removed), confirming that their distinctive role is tied to the inferential complexity introduced by the neutral class.
blocks.zh:
基于SHAP的分析和衰减研究验证了该功能集通过互补运行. 分类的主要动力是结构-关系特征,尤其是L17(单一最预测特征)和E8(第二预测特征),两者在三类和二进制设置中都占主导地位. 分布式信息特性最能显著地促进中性类检测:它们除去在三级SICK的中性F1中产生2.6分的亏损,而L10是个人最稳定的DI特性,
捕捉到剩余分布式一致性在删除了模拟兼容的术语后,说明它是这种组级效应的主要贡献者. 在二进制分类中,SR特性单独捕捉到大部分可用的引号信号,而DI特性在去除时贡献微弱(−−−0.3分),确认其独特作用与中性类引入的引号复杂性有关.

blocks.en:
The analysis yields four main conclusions: (i) entailment is most reliably detected through Structural-Relational alignment signals, particularly the weighted interaction of semantic groups and lexical-semantic coverage; (ii) contradiction requires the full integration of lexical opposition, structural incompatibility, and distributional-informational directionality, as confirmed by the 15.1-point drop in contradiction F1 when SR features are removed; (iii) the neutral class justifies the full feature
set’s complexity, as it is precisely where the interaction of both dimensions is most needed; and (iv) world knowledge gaps remain the primary limitation, defining the boundary condition where no feature combination can compensate for the absence of event-level mutual exclusivity relations.
blocks.zh:
分析得出四个主要结论:(一) 通过结构-关系对齐信号,特别是语义组的加权相互作用和语义-语义覆盖,最可靠地检测到内涵;(二) 矛盾需要充分整合语义对立,结构不兼容,以及分布-信息方向性,在删除SR特征时,矛盾F1的15.1点下降证实了这一点;(三) 中性类为完全特征提供了理由.
(四) 世界知识差距仍然是首要的限制因素,界定任何特征组合都不能弥补事件层面相互排斥关系的边界条件。

blocks.en:
We identify four priorities for future research. First, the model’s primary failure mode —world knowledge gaps, as illustrated by Case 2— motivates the integration of commonsense knowledge beyond ConceptNet’s current coverage, particularly for event-level mutual exclusivity relations not well represented in its graph. Second, implicit negation
expressed through adverbial or aspectual modifiers ( almost , barely , stop ) represents a systematic source of error that calls for dedicated feature engineering targeting pragmatic phenomena. Third, the current entity alignment is
flat; a recursive extension that handles nested modification structures would extend coverage to more complex syntactic configurations. Finally, evaluation on adversarially constructed benchmarks such as ANLI ( Nie et al. 2020 ) and HANS ( McCoy, Pavlick, and Linzen 2019 ) remains a priority to assess robustness beyond the SICK family of datasets.
blocks.zh:
我们确定了未来研究的四个优先事项。 首先,如案例2所示,模型的主要失败模式——世界知识差距——促使将常识知识纳入概念网目前涵盖范围之外,特别是用于其图中未充分反映的事件一级相互排他关系。 第二,默示否定
通过旁观或侧面修饰(几乎,勉强,停止)表示,是一种系统性的错误来源,需要针对实用现象的专用特性工程。 第三,目前的实体对齐是
平面;处理嵌入式修改结构的递归扩展将覆盖范围扩大到更为复杂的合成配置. 最后,对诸如ANLI(Nie等人,2020年)和HANS(McCoy,Pavlick,和Linzen,2019年)等对抗性构建的基准的评价,仍然是评估SICK系列数据集之外的稳健性的优先事项.

blocks.en: Our work demonstrates that thorough linguistic analysis and feature engineering remain viable for NLI and that the goals of accuracy and transparency need not be in conflict. By decomposing the semantic relations between P P and H H into interpretable sub-representations and operationalizing their information change as inferential evidence, our model achieves near-state-of-the-art performance with full explainability, challenging the assumption that massive transformers are needed to obtain competitive results. In domains where transparency is essential, characterizing what a model learns constitutes a scientific contribution in itself. We hope this work will encourage further exploration of hybrid approaches that combine symbolic precision with statistical learning, fostering a more productive dialogue between linguistic theory and computational modeling of inference.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作表明,透彻的语言分析和特征工程对于国家语言研究所来说仍然是可行的,准确性和透明度的目标不需要冲突。 通过将P和HH之间的语义关系分解为可解释的子代表,并将其信息变化作为推论证据来操作,我们的模型以完全可解释性的方式实现了近乎最先进的性能,挑战了需要大规模变压器才能获得竞争性结果的假设. 在透明度至关重要的领域,描述一个模型所学到的东西本身就是科学贡献。 我们希望这项工作将鼓励进一步探索将象征精确度与统计学习相结合的混合方法,促进语言理论与计算推论模型之间更有成效的对话.
